jobs.description:
An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

 

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

 

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• Ideally, you have around 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in an accounting department. Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.
• You are confident using SAP and MS Office.
• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Jet Engin Inspector | Zaventem | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Jet Engin Inspector wanted for a company in Zaventem. The company is a worldwide leader in design, development and production of aircraft engines.

Assess parts (serviceable, repairable, or scrap) using the ERP system and initiate necessary actions. Apply appropriate materials, tools, and methods. Ensure traceability by administratively closing completed tasks. 
Determine the future configuration of parts or modules. Conduct incoming inspections of repaired or purchased parts. 
Carry out final inspections after internal repairs.

• You are stress-resistant and take responsibility

• You are proactive and can take decisions in urgent situations. 
 
• You have a very good knowledge of technical English, with some knowledge of Dutch or French and you are willing to improve your skills. 
 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts (from 6am to 2pm, and from 2pm to 10pm). 
 
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and supporting your colleagues.Requirements: 
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU passport or valid work and residence permit). 
Visa or permit assistance is not provided.

• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.

• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
 
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.

• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.
